Name: Yerba Mate drink
Author: Kacegz
Description:
[b][size=6]Mate[/size]

[/b][size=3]Mod adds a traditional South American caffeinated drink which gives player +2 speed and +10 max stamina for 1 minute 30 seconds (I might change it in the future just like the sprite, sorry I'm not really good at pixel art). You can buy the drink in saloon for 700g.[/size]
[size=4][b]
How to install:[/b]
[/size][size=3]1. Download and install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]Json Assets[/url].
2. Download and unzip mod into StardewValley/Mods.
3. Enjoy! :)[/size]
